detail: The expected result checks availableStock 0 only 'if the field is part of the item shape'. Name the exact JSON property from GET /items/{id} and require it to equal 0, so the out-of-stock check is concrete.

The case requires that the section on /item/1002 contains no card named 'Bravo Pack'. The test uses `expect(next.locator('.catalog-product .name')).not.toContainText(['Bravo Pack'])` on a multi-element locator, a loose array-negation that does not strictly assert absence. A `toHaveCount(0)` on a locator filtered by hasText would be exact. The heading check also uses a loose `.or(...first())`.
